description.wordGroup: Creates a private copy of this group and its words, with you as their author.
description.groupCollection: Creates a private copy of this collection, closed to contributions, with you as its author.

done.wordGroup: Group duplicated. It is private and closed to contributions.
done.groupCollection: Collection duplicated. It and its copied groups are private and closed to contributions.
done.groupCollectionLinked: Collection duplicated. It is private and closed to contributions; its groups were not copied.

description.copied: The groups you can see are copied with their words, with you as their author. Your own groups are kept as they are.
description.linked: The copy contains the original groups, without copying them: their changes will show in it.
